identity.title: LER 2026-001-00 for Virgil C. Summer Nuclear Station, Unit 1 (VCSNS), Operations Prohibited by Technical Specifications (TS)

cause.proximate_text: Past non-compliances were the result of inadequate procedural guidance to ensure placement of inoperable channels in the tripped condition within 1 hour. The February 7 event was caused by inadequate procedural guidance, as well as an ineffective interim corrective action.
cause.theme: Inadequate procedural guidance / ineffective interim corrective action

nodes.theme: Inadequate procedural guidance / ineffective interim corrective action
nodes.proximate_text: Past non-compliances were the result of inadequate procedural guidance to ensure placement of inoperable channels in the tripped condition within 1 hour. The February 7 event was caused by inadequate procedural guidance, as well as an ineffective interim corrective action.

nodes.display_name: Trip of Main Feedwater Pumps Start Motor-Driven Pumps instrumentation channel
Inadequate procedural guidance for placing inoperable trip channel in tripped condition within 1 hour
nodes.description: Multiple procedures governing Feedwater System operation (relied on by startup/shutdown General Operating Procedures) did not ensure inoperable 'Trip of MFPs Start Motor-Driven Pumps' channels were placed in the tripped condition within the required 1-hour window.

nodes.display_name: At least eight past instances of LCO 3.3.2 Table 3.3-3 Item 6.g noncompliance
nodes.description: Review on January 21, 2026 identified at least eight instances within the last three years where the procedure vulnerability resulted in noncompliance with LCO 3.3.2, Table 3.3-3, Item 6.g.
Standing Order SO 26-001, issued January 22, 2026 to provide interim guidance, did not prevent a recurrent TS noncompliance on February 7, 2026.

nodes.display_name: Mode 2 entry without secured MFPs tripped (Feb 7 TS 3.0.4 violation)
nodes.description: On February 7, 2026, during startup, VCSNS entered Mode 2 (approximately 0500 EST) without all secured Main Feedwater Pumps placed in a tripped condition, violating TS 3.0.4 and LCO 3.3.2, Table 3.3-3, Item 6.g.

nodes.display_name: Operations prohibited by Technical Specifications (TS 3.0.4 / LCO 3.3.2 noncompliance)

properties.note: No safety consequences; discovered at 0934 EST, secured MFPs immediately tripped, restoring compliance.

nodes.display_name: Issue Standing Order SO 26-001 for interim compliance guidance
Prepare and process permanent procedure changes
Implement additional interim actions after February 7 event
Complete Root Cause Evaluation of recurrent noncompliance

properties.note: Findings and additional corrective actions to be communicated in a future supplement to this LER.

edges.evidence: instrumentation channel governs trip of Main Feedwater Pumps within the Feedwater System operating procedures

chain: inadequate procedural guidance [cause TBD/provisional] -> at least 8 past LCO 3.3.2 noncompliances (identified Jan 21) -> SO 26-001 interim guidance issued but ineffective -> Feb 7 Mode 2 entry with secured MFPs untripped (TS 3.0.4 violation) -> TS noncompliance / operations prohibited (~4h34m, discovered & corrected; no safety consequences) [Root Cause Evaluation ongoing, supplement expected]
